What to expect

How Futura Financial works with you

Experienced Guidance

A licensed team walks through your situation and explains each program in plain language before you commit to anything.

Competitive Rates

As a brokerage, Futura Financial shops loan options on your behalf. Current pricing always comes from a conversation, not this page.

Fast Processing

Clear document checklists and a streamlined application path keep your file moving once you decide to proceed.

The process

Three steps to a decision

  1. Talk through your goals

    Call 626-442-1888 or send a note. The first conversation is about your plans, timeline, and budget.

  2. Compare programs

    Review the programs that fit your situation, with the trade-offs of each explained clearly.

  3. Apply when ready

    Complete the secure online application and follow a documented checklist through closing.
